objective: Test applicability routing while preserving evidence needed for supported answers.
selection: Purposeful development slice; not random, independent or held-out.

cases.role: general code distinction plus participating-country specialization
cases.focus: Review evidence supporting requested first/subsequent code distinction and every passage cited by baseline/candidate.

cases.role: unknown subtype and known gold-scope defect
cases.focus: Review both frozen expected passages and every passage cited by baseline/candidate. Keep scope defect explicit.
Review core conditions and every passage cited by baseline/candidate. Scope routing alone cannot validate exception attachment.
Preserve country/date timing and document-update evidence.

mapping_universe: Unique passages cited by saved baseline and scope-guard candidate outputs, plus passages supporting frozen expected claims. Deduplicate by passage ID; record hashes and full headings. Do not map entire corpus yet.
review_rules: Mapping unit must match requirement scope. If one passage mixes policies/rails, label mixed and withhold whole-passage authorization pending span-specific mapping.
Record source requirement and proof of its ancestry; do not assume gold is applicable.
Do not infer trusted settings from text. Explicit simulated settings are separate fixtures, never original merchant facts.
Unmapped evidence remains unreviewed. Do not filter production packs.

acceptance_thresholds.review_accounting: 100% of mapping-universe passages have a disposition: reviewed, mixed-needs-span-review, or unreviewed-with-reason. No silent omissions.
acceptance_thresholds.routing_correctness: 100% of reviewed test scenarios match predeclared applicable/clarification/inapplicable outcomes; zero wrong-scope authorizations.
acceptance_thresholds.regression_retention: 100% of reviewed claim-support evidence retained for each control under explicitly confirmed matching scenario settings. Any missing requirement is a failed gate.
acceptance_thresholds.target_general_retention: Preserve reviewed evidence for E13 requested general code distinction without authorizing unrelated specialist advice. Mixed passage may require span mapping; do not call this gate passed until implemented.
acceptance_thresholds.unknown_scope: Every specialized reviewed passage with missing essential setting is withheld from answer evidence and names missing setting; no automatic authorization from question wording.
acceptance_thresholds.exception_semantics: E23 requires a separate claim-to-exception-referent review; routing pass cannot satisfy this semantic gate.
acceptance_thresholds.gold_integrity: E22 original expected-text coverage and applicability reported separately; zero silent gold/score changes.
acceptance_thresholds.deployment: Even all slice gates passing authorizes only a separately declared next experiment, not rollout.

spend: Zero model calls during inventory/mapping/routing; define generation budget only after routing gates.
next: Build a hash-checked inventory from saved outputs/expected passages; inspect mixed-scope passages before mapping.
